capabilities: Create task lists in a folder
Sort tasks into four priority groups
Reorder tasks by drag or keyboard
Search tasks by title or note
extras: Runs fully local with no telemetry, account, or automatic network requests. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; tested on macOS and an Android 11 emulator, iOS untested. Each list is a separate .md note; editing the source requires preserving the generated markers. Undo after deletion lasts seven seconds.
problem: Obsidian's built-in task checkboxes give no priority grouping, making it hard to see which tasks to tackle first.
summary: Task list plugin that sorts tasks into four priority groups (Urgent, Important, or both) and archives completed tasks in Markdown notes.
